FN-ARGAUQ7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 477
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/01/2025
House Bill 477 as introduced would authorize certain nonprofit agricultural organizations to
offer health benefits to its members and their families. This bill would levy a 1.3% premium tax
on premiums collected on these benefits and would provide for these revenues to be deposited to
the State General Fund, less an administrative fee of up to 2% of the collections that may be
retained by the Department of Revenue (DOR).
Also, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Insurance and
DOR to administer the provisions of this bill.

FN-ARGAUQ7-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 477
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 477 as reported by the Committee on Health would authorize certain nonprofit
agricultural organizations to offer health benefits to its members and their families. This bill
would levy a 1.3% premium tax on premiums collected on these benefits and would provide for
these revenues to be deposited to the State General Fund, less an administrative fee of up to 2%
of the collections to be credited to the Insurance Department Fund.
Also, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Insurance to
administer the provisions of this bill.
